extName.message: Agent Lens: VALORANT agents on Twitch

extDescription.message: See which VALORANT agent every Twitch streamer is playing, and filter streams by agent or role. Runs on your computer.

filterHint.message: Pick an agent or role to show only those streams.

settingMinViewersHint.message: Smaller streams aren't downloaded: less data and work on big directories.

emptyFilter.message: Nobody on this page is playing that right now. Scroll down to load more streams, or clear the filter.

loadPausedMin.message: the rest are under {min} viewers, not loaded

loadMoreHint.message: While a filter is on, Twitch would keep loading streams only for them to be hidden, which makes going back to this page slow. Loads {count} more.

emptyFilterMin.message: Nobody with {min}+ viewers is playing that right now. Clear the filter or lower Min. viewers.

emptyFilterCap.message: Nobody in the loaded streams is playing that right now. Load more, or clear the filter.

myAgentsEmpty.message: Choose your agents in the Agent Lens button in the toolbar.

badgeEarlier_one.message: {name} was playing {agent} {count} minute ago (now between rounds or in a menu)

badgeEarlier_other.message: {name} was playing {agent} {count} minutes ago (now between rounds or in a menu)

badgeSpectating.message: {name} is playing {agent}; dead right now and watching a teammate ({watching})

badgeSpectatingUnknown.message: {name} is dead right now and watching a teammate ({agent}). Their own agent shows up after a later preview.

badgeMaybe.message: {name} is probably playing {agent}. Seen on a death or round-end screen, where the bar can belong to a teammate being watched; a later preview will tell.

badgeScreen.message: {name}: {screen}. No agent to see in this preview; Agent Lens looks again in a minute.

popupNotTwitch.message: Open the VALORANT category or a VALORANT stream on Twitch.

popupPageCount.message: {found} of {total} VALORANT streams on this page identified

popupChannelNone.message: {name} isn't in a match right now.

popupMyAgentsHint.message: Pick the agents you play. They get a star on stream cards and their own filter.

settingQualityHint.message: Reads the score more often; downloads about twice as much.

popupPrivacy.message: Agent Lens looks at the public preview images of VALORANT streams you can see, on your own computer. It sends nothing anywhere and keeps your choices in this browser.
